game.title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
game.blurb: Action-adventure set on the Minotaur's Island, a prequel set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, from Asobo Studio, released 2026-08-27. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: Curiosities

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result, "resonance-a-plague-tale-legacy" (id 1004520, released 2026-08-27, Asobo Studio, published by Focus Entertainment), is the right game; its description sets it 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem and names Sophia and the Minotaur's Island. No StrategyWiki page under this title. aplaguetale.fandom.com answers the API, with about 30 linked pages, including "Sophia", "Theseus", "Minotaur's Island" and a "/Transcript" subpage; names only were looked at, nothing copied (plaguetale.fandom.com returned 404). Steam app 2713000 is "Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy". 19 of 36 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Thirteen of them have falling unlock rates (93 to 62%) from "Blood ties" to "As One", just before "A new beginning" (complete all chapters, 61%), so they look like chapter steps. A few low-rate hidden ones ("Excessive force", "Baitfish", "Close call") may be combat or curiosity goals, but their conditions are secret.
